decision: Produce a US East Coast cut of the Geminids week with local timings rather than one global cut
rationale: The peak instant is 23:52 EST on 13 Dec versus 05:52 CET on 14 Dec, the radiant peaks at 82 deg instead of 73, moonset is 20:42 instead of 20:04, and the Moon-Saturn pass is 5.9 deg at 02:10 instead of 5.5 at 07:09. A viewer in New York told 'after midnight on the 14th' would miss the best hour, so the local numbers matter more than the extra render.
alternatives: One global episode with UTC-agnostic wording (rejected: loses the concrete 'look now' value)
Captions only in the description (rejected: most viewers never read them)
